title: Scope Celebration to Correct Elements
description: Introduce a new shared UI element state `celebrating` (attribute `data-celebrated="true"`) applied everywhere via the existing cross-language state model (ui/styling/js/index.ts UiState + ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs UiState). Visual: a spinning conic-gradient border cycling through the three brand colors (primary/secondary/tertiary) whose ring thickness pulses/bursts, following the existing border-loading/border-waiting masked-ring CSS pattern in ui/styling/js/ui.css. Wire it as the completion celebration fired when an introduction step advances by the user performing the taught action (framework/renderer/react/index.tsx advanceIntroductionStep). Add a transient celebrateElements(selector, durationMs) stamping helper in ui/js/react/index.tsx, extend WindowSilhouetteBorderKind + resolveWindowSilhouetteBorderKind, mirror the enum in ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (Celebrating variant + celebrate_if helper), and extend existing tests (ui/styling/js/index.test.ts, ui/js/react/index.tsx in-source tests, ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs cfg(test)). No new files outside this ticket folder; all edits within existing regions/subregions.
summary: Fixed celebration leaking to unrelated UI controls. Removed blanket celebrateCompletedInteraction from panel tabs, toggles, buttons, actions, action-group items, and window pane chrome toggles. Celebration now only fires for the introduction step's introduce target via advanceIntroductionByDoing → celebrateElements, and for newly placed catalogue-drop meshes via celebrateWorldInstances. Added regression tests that ordinary tab/toggle presses do not stamp data-celebrated.
